```js
// F7: compare priorities case-insensitively, after trimming, and only within P1-P4.
function normPriority(p) {
  if (typeof p !== "string") return null;
  const v = p.trim().toUpperCase();
  return /^P[1-4]$/.test(v) ? v : null;
}
function priorityMatches(got, ref) {
  const g = normPriority(got);
  return g !== null && g === normPriority(ref);
}
```
